answer_1.quote: To solve hybrid question answering (HQA), we propose HYBGRAG.
answer_1.outputs: retrieved documents satisfying the relational and textual aspects of the question

answer_2.quote: We use the default evaluation metrics provided by STARK, which are Hit@1, Hit@5, Recall@20 and mean reciprocal rank (MRR), to evaluate the performance of the retrieval task.

answer_3.quote: The LLM validator C_val aims to validate if the top references retrieved X meet the requirements specified by the question, which is a binary classification task.
